issues.explanation: This compositional phrase hides the personal name 曹腾 and should be split into 曹腾 and 养子.
issues.suggested_fix: Use separate segments 曹腾 (name) and 养子 (word).

issues.explanation: Here 字 means a courtesy name, not a letter.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “courtesy name; style name.”

issues.explanation: In 好游猎, 好 is pronounced hào and means “to enjoy/be fond of.”
issues.suggested_fix: Use pinyin hào and gloss “to enjoy; be fond of.”

issues.explanation: Here 善 means “to be good at,” not simply “good.”
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “to be skilled at; be good at.”

issues.explanation: In 曾装病, 曾 means “once; formerly,” not the surname Zeng.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “once; previously.”

issues.explanation: In 装病, 装 means “to pretend/fake,” not “adornment.”
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “to pretend; fake.”

issues.explanation: In 二十岁, 岁 means “years old/age,” while the current dictionary-style gloss does not explain the local use.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “years old; years of age.”

issues.explanation: In 举孝廉, 举 means “to recommend/select for office,” not merely a character variant.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “to recommend; nominate.”

issues.explanation: 孝廉 is a historical lexicalized term for a recommended candidate/official category; splitting it into isolated characters hides that useful term.
issues.suggested_fix: Combine 孝 and 廉 as 孝廉 and gloss it in the historical context.

issues.explanation: 孝廉 is a historical lexicalized term; 廉 should not be taught as an isolated surname-like character here.
issues.suggested_fix: Combine 孝 and 廉 as 孝廉.

issues.explanation: In 任洛阳北部尉, 任 means “to take up/serve in an office,” not the surname Ren.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “to serve as; take up the post of.”

issues.explanation: 北部尉 is the historical official title in this context; splitting 北部 from 尉 hides the title.
issues.suggested_fix: Combine 北部尉 as the office title and gloss it as “northern-district commandant.”

issues.explanation: 尉 is part of the official title 北部尉, not a personal name.
issues.suggested_fix: Mark it as a word/title segment within 北部尉.

issues.explanation: In 以五色棒, 以 means “using/with,” not an abbreviation for Israel.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “using; with.”

issues.explanation: 五色 is a natural lexical unit meaning “five-colored”; splitting it into isolated numeral and color characters is less useful here.
issues.suggested_fix: Combine 五 and 色 as 五色.

issues.explanation: 五色 is a natural lexical unit meaning “five-colored” in 五色棒.
issues.suggested_fix: Combine 五 and 色 as 五色.

issues.explanation: 棒 is a noun meaning “stick/baton,” not a particle.
issues.suggested_fix: Mark 棒 as a word and gloss it as “stick; baton.”

issues.explanation: Here 威名 means a fearsome or prestigious reputation, not specifically fame for fighting prowess.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “fearsome reputation; renown.”

issues.explanation: 威名大震 means that his reputation became widely renowned; “be greatly shaken” misleads the learner about the phrase.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “to become widely renowned; to resound greatly.”

issues.explanation: In 到颍川后, 后 means “afterward/after,” not the surname Hou.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “after; afterward.”

issues.explanation: 奉命 means “to receive/obey an order,” not “to offer.”
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss 奉 as “to receive/obey respectfully.”

issues.explanation: In 奉命, 命 means “order; command,” not “life.”
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “order; command.”

issues.explanation: 左丰 is a personal name and should remain together; splitting it produces misleading standalone glosses.
issues.suggested_fix: Combine 左 and 丰 as the name 左丰.

issues.explanation: In 被诬陷下狱, 被 is the passive marker, not “quilt.”
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “被: passive marker; be subjected to.”

issues.explanation: In 击败董卓时, 时 means “when/at the time that,” not the surname Shi.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “when; at the time that.”

issues.explanation: In 三人, 三 means “three,” not the surname San.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “three.”

issues.explanation: 轻慢 is a natural word meaning “to disdain/look down on”; splitting it into “light” and “slow” is materially misleading.
issues.suggested_fix: Combine 轻 and 慢 as 轻慢.

issues.explanation: 慢 is part of the word 轻慢 here, not the standalone adjective “slow.”
issues.suggested_fix: Combine 轻 and 慢 as 轻慢.

issues.explanation: 无礼 is a natural word meaning “rude/impolite”; splitting it into isolated characters hides the useful word.
issues.suggested_fix: Combine 无 and 礼 as 无礼.

issues.explanation: 礼 is part of 无礼 here, not the surname Li.
issues.suggested_fix: Combine 无 and 礼 as 无礼.

issues.explanation: In 要杀他, 要 means “want/intend to,” not the bound form “to demand.”
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “to want to; intend to.”

issues.explanation: In the chapter-ending formula 留待下回分解, 分解 means “explain/reveal what happens,” not “resolve.”
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “to explain; reveal the outcome.”
